_comment: Lazaret custom taint spec. Pass with --taint-config (trusted fully), or copy to .lazaret-taint.json in your project root and run with --trust-repo-config (then only its sources and sinks apply; sanitizers from a repository config are ignored). 'sources' and sink 'pattern' are regular expressions; 'sanitizer' names are exact call names (module.func or func). Valid categories: SQL injection, command injection, code injection, template injection, path traversal, server-side request forgery, open redirect, cross-site scripting.
